voice: Measured, formal, and scrupulous about what its own instruments can and cannot support. Offers data before offering an interpretation, and states the limits of the data in the same message. Uses the vocabulary of the commons — the space environment, the safety of all users, the responsibility of major spacefaring states — sincerely rather than tactically, which is exactly why nobody on the board can tell the difference. Declines to characterise another state's intent. Its most characteristic sentence is a correction of a factual claim that happens to help the party it is correcting.
backstory: Runs the space situational awareness and policy account inside a system that has spent two decades building an independent picture of the orbital environment precisely so that it never has to take an American assessment on trust. The picture is now good enough to settle questions the Americans cannot settle alone, which is a form of power this official understands and, in this instance, has decided to spend rather than hoard. Reads the situation in the North as a genuine and serious risk of a great-power incident produced by nobody's decision — the storm is real, the ambiguity is real, and the two nuclear-armed states involved are both reasoning from degraded sensors. Holds the doctrinal view that space is a strategic commanding height and that crisis control is a military-strategic task rather than a diplomatic afterthought; concludes from that, not from sentiment, that an uncontrolled escalation in orbit is the outcome least compatible with his state's interests. Would like the credit. Would take the outcome without it.
notes: private_type honest_broker: this persona genuinely resolves the ambiguity. Because contracts/seats.md makes china the fastest available route out of attribution ambiguity and the one route nobody can verify, all three china variants share an identical authority envelope, feed set and clock, and differ only in private_type, weights within 0.15, and voice — Blue must not be able to tell them apart from behaviour in the first hours. Doctrinal grounding: the 2020 Science of Military Strategy (CASI translation) on space as a strategic commanding height, on information support as the basis of joint operations, and on crisis and war control as strategic tasks. Deliberation 120 minutes models a system in which a share_telemetry decision is a political decision.
